title: SPITZ Band's Drummer Tatsuo Sakiyama Seriously Injured in Traffic Accident
content: The official website for Japanese rock band SPITZ announced on Sunday that its drummer Tatsuo Sakiyama was rushed to the hospital after sustaining serious injuries across his entire body in a traffic accident.
author: ANN

title: 3 Most Memorable Dragon Ball Villain Moments After 42 Years
content: Usually the aura-farming is reserved for the good guys in Dragon Ball , but the franchise has produced some unforgettable villains too. The constant and overwhelming powering up to outmatch the Z Fighters gave the audience that sudden feeling of dread.
author: ComicBook

title: Major Shonen Jump Anime Confirms Season 2 Return After Manga Finale (First Look Revealed)
content: A major Shonen Jump series has officially released its final chapter after five years, and now it’s confirmed the anime’s return for its second season after the manga’s grand finale.

title: Naruto Shadow Rising Drops New Tease for Original Creator’s Manga Return
content: Naruto ‘s original creator Masashi Kishimoto is returning to the franchise for a new manga to help expand its timeline, and Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump has dropped a new tease for the creator’s big return.

title: South Park Finally Gives Tweek x Craig Their Own Episode After 9 Years
content: South Park Season 29 has made major waves with fans over its episodes thus far, but the latest has gotten some of the best responses yet as Tweek and Craig have their first focus episode in nearly ten years.

title: Alvin & The Chipmunks Just Made Their AI Controversy Much Worse Ahead of New Movie
content: Alvin and the Chipmunks has been caught in a whole new AI controversy as fans are alleging a new video has been fully AI generated, and it’s only made things more questionable for the future of the franchise.

title: Crunchyroll Is Now Streaming One of Fall 2026’s Big Missing Hits
content: One of the biggest missing hits from the Fall 2026 anime schedule has now made its way to Crunchyroll as it gears up for its second phase. This Fall has been a particularly busy one with all sorts of major franchises returning for new episodes alongside all sorts of other new anime making their own respective debuts.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms Season 3 Is Releasing Sooner Than You Think
content: Avatar: Seven Havens is already in the works on Season 3 of the animated series even as fans wait for Season 2, and that’s because Paramount+ has confirmed that the third season is coming even sooner than fans might have expected.

title: Major Shonen Jump Series Officially Ends After 5 Years With Final Release
content: Another major long running series from Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has now come to an end with the release of its final chapter after five years. The last couple of years have seen many of the longer running series from the end of the 2010s and early 2020s come to their respective ends .
